title: Inefficient ActiveRecord count usage
summary: Using count, length, or size without understanding query/materialization behavior can create unnecessary database work or memory usage.
rationale: In Rails, count, length, and size have different behavior depending on whether a relation is loaded. Misuse can trigger extra queries or load records just to count them.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large collections, high-traffic Rails actions, background jobs, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use exists? for existence checks, count for database-side counts, and size only when the loaded/unloaded behavior is intentional.
remediation.tradeoffs: May require refactoring for readability, query shape, or framework conventions.
